_comment: Stage 1 of the 'freie Szene, nur Gesicht uebernehmen' local pipeline: SDXL + InstantID (cubiq/ComfyUI_InstantID) generates a brand-new scene image from {{PROMPT}}, using the character reference photo ({{IMAGE_FILENAME}}, already uploaded via ComfyUIProvider.upload_image) ONLY for facial identity via ApplyInstantID's InstantID conditioning + ControlNet - the reference photo's background/composition/pose is NOT reused, unlike the plain image-to-video path (wan22_image_to_video.json), which locks the whole first frame to the reference photo. The resulting image (stage 1 output) is then fed as the start_image into the EXISTING, unchanged Wan2.2 image-to-video workflow (stage 2) - see ComfyUIProvider._generate() / _generate_identity_scene_image(). Requires the ComfyUI_InstantID custom node (installable via ComfyUI Manager) plus its three model files: models/instantid/ip-adapter.bin, models/controlnet/instantid/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors, models/insightface/models/antelopev2/*, and an SDXL checkpoint in models/checkpoints/ (filename set by {{CHECKPOINT_NAME}}, project setting Project.comfyui_identity_checkpoint). None of this is bundled with VOXini - the user downloads it once, all free/open weights. This template's exact node graph has NOT been run against a live ComfyUI instance in this environment (no ComfyUI available here) - it was hand-built to match cubiq/ComfyUI_InstantID's official example workflow (examples/InstantID_basic.json) node-for-node, but it needs a real live test on the user's machine before being trusted, same honesty caveat as any other change made without a running app to verify against.
